name: Aiseline Eleanor Duplain
description: A talented 2-star mage with an inferiority complex who receives guidance from the protagonist.

name: Alon Palatio
description: An overworked modern office worker who reincarnated to mentor and save future villains.

name: Amelia Rayfold
description: The eldest daughter of the Rayfold family, a highly capable and dangerous strategist.

name: Belinda
description: A fan-favorite character often acting as a caretaker to the protagonist.

name: Bella
description: Denise personal maid from the Veltus family. She is exceptionally patient when dealing with her highly self-centered mistress and often demonstrates more critical thinking and better judgment than her employer herself.

name: Byeok Tae-San
from: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
description: The reincarnated Heavenly Demon who desires a quiet life but is constantly drawn into conflicts.

name: Cheon Pa-Gu
description: Also known as Gu Cheonpa, a wise senior figure to Geom Mugeuk and a former Demon Supreme.

name: Cho Seoran
from: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
description: She is a respected female healer known as the 'Medicine King' and hails from the Thousand Medicine Hall. Regarded as one of the most promising talents of her generation, she is widely considered a leading candidate to one day become a Divine Physician.

name: Daisy Fager
from: The Peaceful Life of a Maid Who Hides Her Power and Enjoys It
description: Formerly a legendary hero named Andert, she now disguises herself as a maid seeking a quiet life.

name: Dan Soh-Ok
description: The Secret Order Lord of the Demonic Palace, an unfortunate genius girl unable to practice martial arts.

name: Danyoung
from: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
description: a Courtesan of the Fragrant Flower Tower ,a courtesan house ranked among the Top Three in Wuhan but notably, it was not owned by the Golden Wall Merchant Guild.

name: Denise Liniere Veltus
description: Denise is the youngest daughter of the Veltus family. Confident in her beauty, she pursued magic from a young age in hopes of earning praise and admiration.

name: Derrick
description: Derrick is a gifted young man who rose from the slums. After learning magic alongside fellow beggars and later studying under a noble mentor, he became a mercenary and now works as a magic tutor for noble ladies.

name: Diela Catherine
description: The youngest daughter of House Duplain, a talented mage with a fiery temperament and a troubled past.

name: Elenee Mavroch
from: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World
description: A princess seeking aid after her kingdom was overrun by the forces of the Demon Realm.

name: Ellente Alfione Belmiard
description: A talented noble mage who overcame her insecurities through Derek's guidance and eventually fell in love with him.

name: Feline
description: A mercenary girl who hides deadly combat skills behind a calm and unassuming appearance.

name: Fenia Kraisinne
description: A prodigious wizard and vice tower lord whose extraordinary talent is matched only by her overwhelming arrogance.

name: Fiote
description: Also known as Piote, a male personal priest to Ghislain who is frequently mistaken for a female.

name: Geom Mugeuk
description: The protagonist of Absolute Regression, seeking revenge and mastery over the martial arts.

name: Geom Muyang
description: A key figure in the Heavenly Demon Cult and a relative of Geom Mugeuk.

name: Geom Woojin
description: The Heavenly Demon and Cult Lord, a powerful leader who deeply cares for his sons.

name: Ghislain Fenris
description: Formerly a legendary Mercenary King, he regressed to his younger self to build a power base and avoid past mistakes.

name: Gillion
description: The Vanguard of Cecil Perdium, a towering man who is deeply devoted to his daughter Rachel.

name: Go Wol
description: A trusted strategist whose unwavering loyalty lies with the Sky Heaven Cult Master.

name: Heinkel
description: Archmage Heinkel, the Chalice of Beginnings. After the forgotten era of Gods, she was the first one to reach rank eight

name: Hundred Flowers Tower Owner
from: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
description: The mysterious owner of the Fragrant Flower Tower, renowned for her beauty and influence.

name: Hwa Ok
from: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
description: A powerful information broker who leads both the Golden Jade Tower and the Hao Gate's Yichang branch.

name: Jimin
description: A cheerful former bookworm who grew up to become a successful comic author.

name: Kalia Zenonia
description: The eldest daughter of House Zenonia who became its count and a founding member of Alon's faction, Kalpa.

name: Ketal
from: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World
description: An overpowered barbarian who treats the fantasy world as a dream but turns dangerous when threatened.

name: Loria Altia
description: The youngest daughter of House Altea who defied her fate and rose to become the family's duke.

name: Marselia Hasiane Karusia
from: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World
description: The powerful Elven Queen of the Leaf Clan, revered for her unrivaled archery magic.

name: Milleina Akasha
from: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World
description: The devoted daughter of the Akasha merchant family who risked her life to save her family from debt.

name: Myaon
description: The leader of Ancient Tracker, a prestigious guild ranked among the Five Great Guilds.

name: Rachel
description: A once-frail young girl whose life was transformed after recovering from a long illness.

name: Rinne
description: A senator and relic appraiser whose knowledge stems from the mysterious Library of Eternity.

name: Ronia De Refelz
description: A prodigious mage from House Lefelz known for her spoiled princess-like demeanor.

name: Rosalyn Branford
description: A brilliant noblewoman who overcame a debilitating illness and became known for her grace, intelligence, and quiet determination.

name: Seolrang
description: A powerful beastwoman warrior seeking revenge against the Black Dragon and a true family of her own.

name: Serine
description: A young aspiring warrior raised by the Demon King who dreams of entering the Warrior Academy.

name: Soma - Smilling Demon
description: A cheerful yet dangerous fighter who lives for combat and stands firmly by Geom Mugeuk's side.

name: Soso
from: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
description: A small but capable martial artist known for her unwavering loyalty to Byeok Tae-San.

name: Vanessa
description: A kind-hearted mage apprentice who dreams of reaching the pinnacle of magic despite her lack of natural talent.

name: Yeon Harin
from: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
description: The daughter of the Yeon Family, celebrated as the most beautiful woman in Wuhan.

name: So Yeon-Rang
description: The legendary One Flower Sword Supreme, feared for her unmatched swordsmanship and ruthless ambition.

name: Yutia
description: The Red Moon of Blue Moon and a powerful cardinal who secretly guides events from the shadows.
